eligibility.quote: when trajectories and IO are driven from the ROS side simultaneously
eligibility.reason: E1/E4: the report describes reproducible socket-stream corruption and resulting command errors. E2: the PC driver and controller-executed URScript are separate processes; their incompatible message-length assumptions cross the TCP boundary. Correcting the receiver's read length changes the wire interpretation, not deployment wiring, packaging, or an undeclared firmware behavior. E3: PAIR is appropriate; concurrent command production triggers the failure but the selected interaction is sender-to-receiver.

failed_conditions.quote: driver: sizeof(io_msgs) is 8 bytes, not 8 ints. Fix #107.
failed_conditions.reason: The same command identifiers are interpreted with incompatible payload lengths, supporting definition_mismatch rather than a nominal-type or physical-unit mismatch. The inspected patch replaces socket_read_binary_integer(1+6+1) with socket_read_binary_integer(2) in all four listed IO-command branches; the issue's observed example is digital output.

loudness.quote: `unrecognized command` messages being reported in the ROS log
loudness.reason: These are runtime symptoms after accepting the connection, not build/connect/activation diagnostics. Thus silent_documented is correct under the supplied definition, despite the runtime log messages.

detection_stage.quote: part of the _next_ message in the buffer is read.
detection_stage.reason: The defect manifests during command-stream processing: run.

resolution.reason: The accepted change repairs the read length, but no inspected source demonstrates the simultaneous-IO reproducer working with both selected unit revisions. recommended is supported.

notes: Read issue #107 and its comments, the fix patch, and PR #117. PR #117 contains general successful UR5 testing of a broader driver rewrite, so the specification's absolute suggestion that there is no testing in the sources is too broad. That testing does not establish the particular pinned sender/receiver composition or this reproducer; it does not justify observed. Other changes bundled in that PR are not conditions of this case.
